In the next four weeks you have these payments coming up.

- Electricity advance payment, due Thu 15 Oct 2026: 48.00 €. This is also collected by direct debit [item:itm_kttk9625293w].

**Open, but Ordnung has no due date stored**
- Library overdue fees: 4.50 €. You pay them when you return the items [item:itm_kgsfgwac9wzx].
- Gym fee: 29.90 €. It is collected by direct debit on the 1st of each month [item:itm_chhc59r0d16v].
- Rent deposit (Kaution): 1,560.00 €. The letter says it can be paid in three instalments [item:itm_61wt30mrhybv].
- Deutschlandticket fee: 63.00 €. It is collected by direct debit at the start of each month [item:itm_2s90qr4prp13].

It has hidden text, and the bank account differs from one used before by a similarly named sender. Don't pay until you've checked with the sender, using contact details you already know. A genuine sender whose bank details changed would show the same signs.
